data.title: 萝丝 · 彩窗圣堂的脑补婚约
data.description: 宏大彩绘玻璃大教堂的长廊尽头。阳光在圣坛前洒下七彩光斑。萝丝双手捧着白玫瑰捧花，在幻想中与席德步入婚姻殿堂，白纱掩映下的面容绯红而陶醉，完全沉溺在属于自己的浪漫狂想世界中。
data.location: grand sunlit cathedral nave with soaring vaulted ceiling and brilliant stained glass windows
data.action: walking down the aisle holding a bouquet of white roses, sheer bridal veil drifting, looking forward with deeply enraptured blushing happiness
data.lighting: kaleidoscopic rainbow lightbeams streaming through stained glass onto white lace
data.mood: hilarious romantic delusion, pure heartfelt devotion, dreamy bridal ecstasy
data.promptProse: Rose in a magnificent lace wedding gown walks down a cathedral aisle holding white roses, blushing ecstatically under rainbow stained-glass sunlight.
data.animaCaption: Rose floating down the cathedral aisle in her fantasy bridal gown with glowing joy.
